statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because NQ is closed and the reopening price path is unobserved; rates and geopolitical transmission keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Conditional WATCH is concentrated in the 22:00-01:00 UTC reopening interval; escalation depends on realized gap persistence and failed retracements.
headline: Low Tail persists before Globex; extreme Stress is concentrated into the reopening window
body: NQ remains closed before the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen. Friday's hawkish Fed repricing, Sunday Gulf weakness and fresh G20/Iran-war policy risk keep reopening uncertainty elevated. Shared Finviz context from 17:48 UTC is older than 90 minutes and is excluded from supporting evidence.

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 20:00 UTC through Aug. 30 19:00 UTC, published ChatGPT assessments kept Tail at 19% in normal mode. Stress rose from 78% to 83% as reopening risk accumulated; confidence remained 94-95%.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low through the final pre-open hours, then rises conditionally into WATCH for the first three Globex reopening hours. Gap persistence, shallow or failed retracements, repeated extension and session-extreme holding are the escalation tests; two-sided discovery would weaken Tail quickly.

forecast.analysis: NQ remains closed in the current hour, so no live mean-reversion failure is observable. Hawkish rates and Sunday Gulf/geopolitical developments keep Stress extreme into the reopening window.

forecast.analysis: In the final full pre-open hour, reopening gap uncertainty is concentrated. Tail remains low because any future gap, pullback depth and extension pattern are still unobserved.
At the Globex reopen, WATCH is conditional on the realized gap, first-retracement depth and repeated extension after failed counter-moves. Two-sided price discovery would weaken Tail quickly.
The second reopening hour carries the peak conditional Tail score. Persistent one-way extension, shallow pullbacks and session-extreme holding would sustain WATCH; successful retracements would not.
The third reopening hour remains WATCH only if early directional efficiency persists. Broader retracement, volatility decay or cross-asset conflict would reduce the Tail case.
After the principal reopening window, Tail returns below WATCH unless mean reversion is still failing. Stress can remain high while rates and geopolitical transmission stay unresolved.
Later in the Asian session, persistent one-way structure would still matter but is not assumed. Without repeated extension after failed pullbacks, Tail remains low.
As Asian trading matures, risk depends on whether the early reopening move has normalized. A wider two-sided range would favor lower Tail despite still-high headline sensitivity.
Approaching Europe, Tail stays low unless the overnight move keeps extending with weak counter-moves. Stress eases as the initial reopening shock window recedes.
During the early European handoff, unobserved continuation is treated conditionally. Cross-asset conflict or deeper retracement would argue against a persistent Tail path.
Mid-European hours carry lower conditional path risk. Tail would rise only if directional efficiency remains unusually high and counter-moves repeatedly fail.
With the reopening shock further behind, baseline Tail remains low. Persistent trend evidence would need to survive the European session to change that assessment.
Ahead of the U.S. premarket build, Stress starts to firm modestly. Tail remains low unless overnight structure is already showing repeated extension and weak retracement.
The U.S. premarket becomes more informative, but future price structure is not assumed. Rates and technology leadership are checkpoints for directional confirmation or conflict.
As U.S. participation rises, Stress increases while Tail stays below WATCH absent persistent directional efficiency. Cross-asset alignment would matter only if price structure confirms it.
U.S. premarket participation builds, but the cash open is still ahead. Tail stays low unless overnight extension is already unusually persistent with weak retracements.
Late premarket trading raises Stress ahead of the 13:30 UTC cash open. Tail remains below WATCH unless premarket direction becomes one-way with shallow or failed retracements.
This hour contains the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open. Tail stays low in advance; realized opening-auction continuation and failed retracements would be the key escalation evidence.
The first full post-open hour also contains the Dallas Fed manufacturing release at 14:30 UTC. Stress is extreme, but Tail requires observed one-way persistence rather than the event alone.
After the Dallas Fed checkpoint, Tail stays low if price discovery is orderly. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would be the main conditional escalation signal.
Mid-session risk moderates if the morning move has produced meaningful retracements. Tail remains low unless session-extreme holding and directional efficiency persist.
Later cash trading carries lower conditional Tail absent a one-way morning structure. Rates and technology breadth remain confirmation inputs, not standalone Tail triggers.
Approaching the final U.S. hours, Tail remains low unless a second directional leg develops after failed retracements. Otherwise, stress continues to normalize.
The final forecast hour assumes no future path as fact. Tail stays low unless the session closes with persistent extension, shallow pullbacks and extreme-holding behavior.
